content.text:
Finding submitted.

**Summary:** Section 11.1 sat in walk-away territory — no transition assistance, immediate permanent deletion of Customer Data, and no export or migration support — and it contradicted Sections 11.2 and 11.3. Because 11.2 (machine-readable return) and 11.3 (officer-certified deletion after confirmed return) already carry two preferred elements, a single surgical replacement of 11.1 reaches the preferred position: assistance on expiry or termination for up to six months at Vendor's then-current rates, with Customer Data returned within thirty days.
